reader.requirement: At --std 85 a Format 1 RECORD CONTAINS integer-1 CHARACTERS makes the file's records fixed length, each record holding exactly integer-1 character positions, whatever the size of the record description written (any description no larger than integer-1, per SR1), for every organization and for an FD and an SD alike.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-024/r1_gr3_into.cob (--std 85, run dir r1_gr3_into-001): FW (01 RW PIC X(12)) writes ABCDEFGHIJKL and MNOPQRSTUVWX; FR on the same file, FD FR RECORD CONTAINS 12 CHARACTERS with 01 RR PIC X(5); READ FR INTO W (PIC X(12)) printed 'INTO1 FS=00 W=[ABCDE       ]' and 'INTO2 FS=00 W=[MNOPQ       ]' (the file is read as 12-char records, so the sizing the reader probed is right, but the record handed to the program is the 5-char description). Same at --std 2023 (r1_gr3_into-002). Expected: GR3 makes every record of the file 12 character positions; READ GR8b moves 'the current record' whose 'size ... is determined by rules specified in the RECORD clause' (12), so W=[ABCDEFGHIJKL] with 00; the only other reading (READ GR13: a record longer than the largest description is truncated and a record-length-conflict status is set) wants 04, not 00. The compiler matches neither. Code: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Procedure/Verbs/MoveBinder.cs#BindIntoPhrase sends `new BoundFieldOperand(area)` for a fixed file (comment: 'its current record IS the whole area (GR6 integer-1 bytes)') but `area` is the record-description item (5 chars), not the integer-1-wide record area, so FileModel.RecordContains never reaches the INTO sender. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR3  (3.8.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR3'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR8  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8'; 'OK  §1985:VII.4.4.4 GR13  (4.4.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR13'; 'OK  §1985:III.2  (2. DEFINITIONS)  the text is in the clause' (record area: 'the current number of character positions in the record area is determined by the explicit or implicit RECORD clause'). kb/Work search (INTO + RECORD CONTAINS + integer-1): no note; PB1276 (landed) fixed only the connector width, PB339 only the VARYING sender.
refuter.corrected: a non-conforming verdict (wrong-answer, cause b: same at --std 2023): when every record description of a Format 1 file is shorter than integer-1, the current record a READ/RETURN INTO delivers is the description's width, not integer-1's, so characters GR3 places in the record are lost (repro r1_gr3_into.cob: W=[ABCDE       ] where W=[ABCDEFGHIJKL] is expected). The connector sizing the reader verified is right; the INTO sender in MoveBinder.BindIntoPhrase ignores FileModel.RecordContains.

adjudication.reason: READ INTO where every 01 record is shorter than RECORD CONTAINS gives status 00 and a short move. The text supports two results (the full record with 00, or truncation with 04) and the compiler gives neither. WHICH result is right is not ruled here: it is decided before the fix. 2023 row `GR-13.18.43.4-6`.
